Choose a type and a completion date, and we'll schedule it from today to that day, split into stages and many small steps. Each step is small enough to finish in one or two Pomodoros. Dates and steps can be changed later.
e.g. Master's thesis, “Letter networks of late-Ming literati”
Enter the type, e.g. master's thesis, technical report
Enter the method, e.g. corpus analysis, simulation

The research method determines the steps in the “Data collection” and “Analysis” stages. For example, “Historical source criticism” adds requesting sources, collation and timelines; “Experimental research” adds experimental design, pilot runs and statistical plots; “Clinical research” adds eligibility criteria, IRB review and participant consent. If nothing fits, choose “Other” and fill it in.
